preserved_conflicts: Cover care census prints 1722, after 1743 on the SR186 and SR187 covers. Page 8 prints a census for six provinces: Nord-Kivu 638 (including 279 patients in health facilities outside CTE/CT), Ituri 607, Bas-Uele 43, Nord-Ubangi 29, Tshopo 13 and Sud-Ubangi 3, which sum to 1333 as printed; Haut-Uele prints no census (SR187 printed 73). The national census is withheld and no replacement is derived.

Ituri care prints 607 patients hospitalised (369 confirmed, 238 suspects) and 113 exits (39 recovered, 61 non-cases, 13 deaths of which 9 confirmed); no carry-over or admissions are printed. SR187 printed 397 patients (151 confirmed). With 33 new Ituri cases (13 of them community deaths), 39 recoveries and 9 confirmed deaths, the confirmed count cannot rise from 151 to 369, and no reclassification is printed; the confirmed and suspect split is withheld. Against the SR187 census of 397, the 113 printed exits imply about 323 admissions to reach 607, against 84 admissions printed in SR187; no admissions are printed here. The census is kept as printed and does not close. The 13 deaths of which 9 confirmed compare with 6 intra-CTE confirmed deaths for Ituri in Table 2.

Nord-Kivu care prints 638 patients (139 confirmed, 499 suspects) with an occupancy of 82.7% stated for 359 occupied beds of 434, and 279 patients (8 confirmed, 271 suspects) outside CTE/CT (359 + 279 = 638). The printed rate is the rate for the 359 in CTE/CT, not for the 638; it is kept only as the printed value and beds and occupancy for the 638 are left null. No admissions or exits are printed.

Nord-Ubangi care prints 4 suspect admissions, 7 non-case exits and 29 patients under observation (10 and 19 in its two zones), with occupancy of 88% overall, 50% and 110% in the two zones; 110% cannot arise from 10 patients and a whole number of beds, and the three rates do not fit one bed count, so occupancy is withheld. Against the SR187 census of 28, the printed flow gives 25, not 29; against the 32 patients SR187 reported as receiving meals it gives 29. The census is kept as printed. The printed intra-CTE lethality of 12.5% differs from 1 death among 10 Nord-Ubangi cases in Table 1 (10.0%) and is not promoted.

Bas-Uele care prints 13 suspect admissions, 13 non-case exits and 43 suspects in isolation; no carry-over is printed. SR187 printed 42 suspects in isolation in its census sentence and 43 in its nutrition and SMSPS lines. From the SR187 census of 42, the printed 13 admissions and 13 exits give 42, not 43; from the 43 in the SR187 nutrition and SMSPS lines they give 43. The census is kept as printed.
